from collections import Counter

def transform_g(g):
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep_rows = {r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r])) == 1}
    sep_cols = {c for c in range(W) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(H))) == 1}
    
    def bands(allr):
        res, cur = [], []
        for x in allr:
            if cur and x == cur[-1] + 1:
                cur.append(x)
            else:
                if cur:
                    res.append(cur)
                cur = [x]
        if cur:
            res.append(cur)
        return res
    
    rb = bands([r for r in range(H) if r not in sep_rows])
    cb = bands([c for c in range(W) if c not in sep_cols])
    
    # Find best region (largest special pattern)
    def pattern(i, j, band):
        cells = [band[r][c] for r in band[0] for c in band[1] if isinstance(band, tuple)] or []
        if isinstance(band, list):
            cells = list(band)
        return cells
    
    best = []
    src = (0, 0)
    for i in range(len(rb)):
        for j in range(len(cb)):
            cells = [g[r][c] for r in rb[i] for c in cb[j]]
            mode = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
            p = [(r, c) for r in rb[i] for c in cb[j] if g[r][c] != mode]
            if len(p) > len(best):
                best = p
                src = (i, j)
    
    srb, scb = rb[src[0]], cb[src[1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    
    # Copy anchor region to all other regions
    for i in range(len(rb)):
        for j in range(len(cb)):
            for a, r in enumerate(rb[i]):
                for b, c in enumerate(cb[j]):
